answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 49301 Country: India Title: Nutrela soyabean is halal or haram? Question: I want to ask whether "Nutrela Soyabean chunks" is halal or haram. someone told us that his relative visited there and saw pig's fat in its factory. Can you tell me the real truth by investigating the same.also i would like to know that which soya sauce is halal or haram. Answer ID: 49301 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1578/1042/L=01/1434) Soya bean is a kind of vegetable, there is no harm in using it. We are not sure that it contains pig fat as well as we do not know what the ingredients of soya bean sauce are. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
